function t1.value1(p220, p221, p222)
    local num = tonumber(p220)

    if not num then
        return "User"
    end

    local v1069 = p221 and p221[tostring(num)]

    if type(v1069) == "table" then
        local _tostring = tostring
        local displayName = v1069.displayName

        if not displayName then
            displayName = v1069.username or "User " .. tostring(num)
        end

        return _tostring(displayName)
    end

    local PlayerByUserId = t2.value3:GetPlayerByUserId(num)

    if PlayerByUserId then
        return PlayerByUserId.DisplayName
    end

    if p222 then
        return "User " .. tostring(num)
    end

    local ok, result = pcall(function()
        return t2.value3:GetNameFromUserIdAsync(num)
    end)

    if ok then
        ok = result

        if result then
            ok = result ~= ""
        end
    end

    if ok then
        return tostring(result)
    end

    return "User " .. tostring(num)
end

function RefreshFriends()
    if ZANE_X.friendsBusy and os.clock() - ZANE_X.friendsBusy < 30 then
        return
    end

    ZANE_X.friendsBusy = os.clock()

    local ok, result = pcall(ZANE_X.refreshFriendsImpl)

    ZANE_X.friendsBusy = false

    if not ok then
        warn("[ZANE] friends refresh failed: " .. tostring(result))
    end
end

function t1.value2(p269, p270, p271)
    local v1430 = string.format("%012d", os.time()) .. math.random(100, 999)
    local value11 = t2.value11
    local t94 = {
		Sender = "SYSTEM_CMD",
		TargetId = p269,
		Cmd = p270,
		Val = p271,
		Server = value11
	}
    local v1433 = syn and syn.request

    if not v1433 then
        v1433 = http and http.request

        if not v1433 then
            v1433 = request
        end
